Bars: median of three fresh-process medians; whiskers: full min–max, not confidence intervals.
Isolated preserved images; separate workloads/hosts. These captures predate final release fixes and packaging.
* Direct stock getter work stays AOT behind a Truffle boundary; shared guest access and stock guest interop are distinct.
Full slab interpreter is still 5.652× direct stock time. Baseline includes B4 Phase 1. All 132 memory pairs unchanged.
